newsitem.title: USA: First Federal Savings stock conversion approved.
newsitem.headline: First Federal Savings stock conversion approved.

text.p: First Federal Savings and Loan of Spartanburg on Wednesday said the Office of Thrift Supervision approved its converting to stock form of ownership.
In connection with the conversion, First Federal has formed FirstSpartan Financial Corp to hold all of the outstanding capital stock of First Federal, it said.
Under the plan, FirstSpartan Financial is offering an estimated 3,852,500 shares of common stock at $20 each.

Certain of First Federal's past and present depositors and borrowers will have the opportunity to purchase stock through a subscription offering that closes at 1200 EDT/1600 GMT on June 17, First Federal said.
Any shares that are left over will be offered to the general public, with first priority being given to residents of Spartanburg County, South Carolina, First Federal said.
